description: Generalitat Valenciana: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat Valenciana. Coverage: Generalitat Valenciana. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Telecomunicaciones. Concesiones del UNICO-Banda Ancha en la Comunitat ; Telecomunicaciones. Zonas Elegibles Plan UNICO-Banda Ancha en la Comun; Telecomunicaciones. Cobertura real 5G en la Comunitat Valenciana (2021; Telecomunicaciones. Concesiones del PEBA-NGA en la Comunitat Valencian. Formats seen: PLAIN, WMS, PDF, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
